Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier. As promised, I’m sending the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone focused on the Integration Build Plan. I’ve attached the PDF draft and a lightweight integration spec (spreadsheet) that Dev and I populated after the call.

Summary of the MAP milestone: Integration build plan
- Objective: Deliver production-ready integration between Acme product and Redwood API for text generation + tool-calling with streaming and structured outputs.
- Target close date for this milestone (internally driving to close): 2027-05-14
- High-level milestones & owners:
  1) SDK integration (client + auth) — Owner: Acme dev lead (Jordan) / Redwood SE: Dev Patel
  2) Streaming + SSE support for low-latency UX — Owner: Redwood SE: Dev Patel / Acme FE: Priya
  3) Tool calling integration (internal tools & connectors) — Owner: Acme integrations team / Redwood: Rishi Malhotra
  4) Structured outputs & schema validation — Owner: Acme data team / Redwood SE: Dev Patel
  5) Prod readiness & runbook (auth, keys, monitoring, fallback policy) — Owner: Acme SRE / Redwood: Marissa Cole (AM) + Stephanie Nguyen (Solutions Manager)

Dependencies and blockers
- Sandbox environment & API keys from Redwood (we can provision within 48h after PO)
- Firewall/network access for the Acme staging env to reach Redwood endpoints (details in integration_spec.xlsx)
- SOC2/Infosec checklist answers (we started this on the call; Security questionnaire in progress)
- Finalized acceptance criteria for structured outputs (sample schema + test cases)

Next steps / asks
1) Can you confirm the internal owners (Jordan / Priya) listed above?
2) Please review the attached MAP draft and integration_spec.xlsx; flag any changes by EOD Tue 2027-04-12.
3) If dates/owners look ok, we’ll lock the milestone target of 2027-05-14 and schedule a 60-min technical workshop the week of 2027-04-18 to kick off the build.

Attachments:
- Acme_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (MAP with milestones, responsibilities, and acceptance criteria)
- integration_spec.xlsx (technical checklist: auth, endpoints, streaming options, schema examples)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

Best,

Subject: Re: MAP draft: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs)

Hi Jordan / team —

Thanks for the notes, Jordan. Quick technical confirmation and proposed breakdown from Redwood SE perspective: 

1) SDK / client-side support
- We provide official SDKs for Node + Python that include built-in reconnect/backoff for streaming. For browser-based SSE the recommendation is to use our lightweight client (we can provide a CDN-hosted bundle or an NPM package).
- Estimated time for Acme to wire SDK auth + basic generation: ~2-3 business days if you use the SDK; ~5-7 days if you implement custom EventSource integration.

2) Streaming (SSE)
- Supported: chunked streaming for generation tokens; structured output events for tool-call triggers.
- We’ll supply sample code snippets and a small demo app in the workshop.

3) Tool calling / connectors
- Supported auth flows: OAuth2 (recommended), API key, and service-account JWTs for server-to-server connectors.
- For third-party connectors (ticketing + internal search), we recommend the server-side pattern (Redwood -> your connector service) to avoid exposing keys in the browser.

4) Structured outputs / schema validation
- We support JSON-schema validation hooks and built-in schema enforcement at the model output stage. We’ll work with your data team to lock down the acceptance tests.

Proposed engineering timeline (parallel workstreams):
- Week 1 (kickoff/workshop): align on schema + auth + test data
- Week 2: SDK integration + basic generation wired to staging (Acme devs + Redwood SE pairing)
- Week 3: Streaming + tool-calling connectors integration + end-to-end tests
- Week 4: Structured outputs validation, runbook, monitoring, and production prep

Total estimate: 3–4 weeks to reach milestone readiness given timely sandbox/API provisioning and test data.

Dependencies (technical):
- Sandbox API keys and staging endpoints (Redwood to provision)
- Sample test data for schema validation (Acme)
- Network allowlist entries for staging IPs (Acme infra)

I can run the technical workshop Tue 2027-04-19 10:00 PT and bring a short demo. Let me know if you prefer another slot.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
